data.message: I individually opt in to 18 tons, even if others choose 10—not an all-or-nothing deal. Other 24 fishers: please state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Assuming k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but lowers the weak-recovery stock by 16 tons. This needn't maximize long-run income; intentions aren't binding. Different catches require recalculation.
